command:
set -euo pipefail
export OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=yes OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
cd /tmp

echo "== verify staged pseudopotential against its pinned sha256 =="
printf '%s  %s\n' 0afddde32f30e43fa8d603822f3dd1ddf357e8ff33a1af21eb4982b6e63080d7 Si.psf > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

echo "== SIESTA 5.4.2: bulk Si SCF, 2-rank MPI (the env's whole point) =="
# This is SIESTA's own Tests/01.PseudoPotentials `psf` case (base_si2.fdf + psf.fdf),
# inlined. Running it against the version-matched Si.psf lets the total energy be
# cross-checked against SIESTA's committed reference for 5.4.2.
cat > si.fdf <<'EOF'
SystemName   Si bulk
SystemLabel  psf
%block ChemicalSpeciesLabel
 1  14  Si
%endblock ChemicalSpeciesLabel
NumberOfAtoms       2
NumberOfSpecies     1
PAO.BasisSize       SZP
LatticeConstant     5.430 Ang
%block LatticeVectors
  0.000  0.500  0.500
  0.500  0.000  0.500
  0.500  0.500  0.000
%endblock LatticeVectors
%block kgrid_Monkhorst_Pack
 3 0 0  0.
 0 3 0  0.
 0 0 3  0.
%endblock kgrid_Monkhorst_Pack
MeshCutoff          150.0 Ry
DM.UseSaveDM        F
AtomicCoordinatesFormat  ScaledCartesian
%block AtomicCoordinatesAndAtomicSpecies
    0.000    0.000    0.000   1 #  Si  1
    0.250    0.250    0.250   1 #  Si  2
%endblock AtomicCoordinatesAndAtomicSpecies
EOF
mpiexec -n 2 siesta < si.fdf > psf.out 2>&1

python3 - <<'PY' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import re, sys
fail=[]
def check(label, ok, detail):
    print(f"{label:24s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(label)
out=open("psf.out").read()
# completion sentinel: SIESTA writes this only when the SCF actually converges
conv=re.search(r"SCF cycle converged after (\d+) iterations", out)
check("scf_converged", conv is not None, f"{'yes ('+conv.group(1)+' iters)' if conv else 'NO'}  want the converged line")
# MPI really ran on 2 ranks -- the env exists for the MPI build
nodes=re.search(r"Running on (\d+) nodes", out)
check("mpi_ranks", nodes and int(nodes.group(1))==2, f"{nodes.group(1) if nodes else 'NA'}  want 2 nodes")
# total energy: cross-check against SIESTA's committed 5.4.2 reference (Total = -214.377236 eV)
m=re.search(r"siesta:\s*Total\s*=\s*(-?\d+\.\d+)", out)
tot=float(m.group(1)) if m else 0.0
check("total_energy", abs(tot-(-214.377236))<0.01, f"{tot}  want -214.377236 +/-0.01 (SIESTA 5.4.2 committed reference)")
if fail: print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
PY
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
